name: SyncRanker – All in One SEO Suite
author: SyncRanker

sections.description:
SyncRanker is a 100% Free On-Page SEO Plugin featuring an Automatic 301 Redirect Manager, Link-Change Logger, and Full Page/Post/WooCommerce Product Metadata Control—with ZERO account signup required.

We believe essential SEO tools shouldn’t be hidden behind expensive paywalls. SyncRanker equips your WordPress site with a powerful, enterprise-grade SEO toolkit right out of the box. Manage redirects, optimize metadata, generate XML sitemaps, and analyze your content with absolutely zero SaaS account or API connection required for core features.

🛑 ELIMINATE ACCIDENTAL 404s: The Ultimate Free Redirection Suite

Stop losing search rankings and link equity to dead links! Unlike premium plugins that paywall their redirect managers, SyncRanker offers a robust Free Redirection Suite built right in:

  • Automatic Link-Change Logger: SyncRanker tracks accidental or manual URL changes in real-time.
  • Instant 301 Redirect Injection: Automatically creates 301 redirects when you change a slug or URL, seamlessly preserving your hard-earned SEO juice.
  • Full Redirect Control: Easily create and manage 301, 302, and 410 redirects manually to control your site’s traffic flow perfectly.

⚡ ZERO BLOAT & 100% COMPLIANT

Tired of heavy legacy SEO suites slowing down your site? SyncRanker is designed to be ultra-lightweight:

  • Zero Database Bloat: Optimized to keep your database clean and your site lightning fast.
  • Strict Compliance: Fully compliant with strict WordPress VIP and Plugin Check Performance standards.
  • Replaces Multiple Plugins: Eliminate the need for bulky, bloated legacy SEO plugins AND separate redirect plugins. SyncRanker handles it all cleanly and efficiently.

🏆 THE UNBEATABLE FREE VALUE (SyncRanker vs. Premium SEO Plugins)

☁️ SAAS CLARITY: Free Locally, AI Power When You Need It

SyncRanker is built to run 100% offline and free locally within your WordPress dashboard. You do not need to sign up for anything to use the Redirect Manager, Metadata Control, XML Sitemaps, or the 12-point SEO analyzer.

Optional Cloud Integration: The optional SyncRanker Article Studio SaaS connection is reserved strictly for high-quality, resource-intensive AI content generation, automatic internal linking, and bulk rewriting. We offload these heavy AI processes to our servers so your website’s server stays fast, secure, and unaffected.

🚀 MORE FREE CORE FEATURES:

1-Click Legacy SEO Migration
Effortlessly move your supported SEO metadata into SyncRanker with our streamlined 1-click migration workflow and real-time AJAX batch processing. Seamlessly migrate existing SEO titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and indexing settings from:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
* SEOPress

On-Page 12-Point SEO Analyzer
A real-time analyzer right in your post editor:
* SEO Scoring & SERP snippet preview
* Title and meta description analysis
* Keyword and topic checks
* Table of contents detection & featured image alt-text verification

XML Sitemaps & Webmaster Verification
Generate a clean, hierarchical XML sitemap accessible instantly at /sync-sitemap.xml. Easily verify your site with Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Baidu, Yandex, and Pinterest.

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to SyncRanker cloud services:
* SyncRanker Platform: (https://syncranker.com) Used ONLY for optional account authentication, remote AI article generation, and advanced cloud AI features.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for SyncRanker Connector or upload syncranker-connector.zip.
  3. Click Install Now and Activate.
  4. Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes once to flush rewrite rules for /sync-sitemap.xml.
  5. (Optional) Go to SyncRanker in your sidebar to connect your cloud workspace for advanced AI writing features.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account to use the Redirect Manager?

No! The Redirect Manager, URL tracking, Metadata editor, XML Sitemap, and On-Page Analyzer are 100% free and work locally on your WordPress site without any account creation.

How does the Automatic Redirect Manager work?

When you modify a page, post, or WooCommerce product URL (slug), SyncRanker detects the change and automatically logs an instant 301 redirect from the old URL to the new one, preventing 404 errors and preserving your SEO rankings.

Can I migrate from my current SEO plugin?

Yes! SyncRanker features a 1-click migration tool supporting Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress.

Is SyncRanker compatible with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. Use our tools to optimize WooCommerce product metadata and manage product URL redirects flawlessly.

When do I need the SyncRanker Cloud/SaaS connection?

The optional cloud connection is only required if you want to use our resource-intensive AI features, such as the AI SEO Writer, Article Rewriter, and Automatic Internal Link Injection. This ensures your local server performance remains perfectly optimized.
sections.changelog:
3.4.1

  • New: Added automated Open Graph (OG) social meta tags injection for single posts and pages.
  • New: Added Pillar / Cornerstone content selector in SEO Meta Box with REST API synchronization.
  • Enhancement: Standardized plugin name and updated metadata handling.
  • Fix: Hardened output escaping and strict sanitization across admin and REST endpoints.

3.4.0

  • Major Feature: 4-in-1 Legacy SEO Migration Engine (Seamless 1-click batch import from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress).
  • Feature: On-Page SEO Distribution Hub & Studio Filter Endpoints for SyncRanker AI CMS (/studio/overview, /studio/posts).
  • Fix: Multi-engine Webmaster Verification meta tag rendering (Google, Bing msvalidate.01, Baidu, Yandex, Pinterest).
  • Performance: Optimized REST API routes for external Studio management and content synchronization.
  • Enhancement: Added 1:1 Redirect Manager with automated slug change tracking.
  • Compatibility: Fully tested and compatible up to WordPress 7.1.

3.3.2

  • Feature: Added built-in Redirect Manager (301, 302, 410) with automatic slug-change tracking.
  • Feature: Added visual SEO Score color indicators (Red, Orange, Green, SyncRanker Blue) to Post list columns and Top Admin Bar.
  • Fix: Resolved minor frontend/backend context switching logic for the admin bar SEO score.
  • Tweak: Extensive WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) code sanitization and security hardening.

3.3.1

  • Enhancement: Implemented smart 3-tier “Waterfall” fallback algorithm in REST API for contextual internal link discovery.
  • Enhancement: Tier 1 matches semantic focus keywords/topics, Tier 2 fills gaps via shared category taxonomy, and Tier 3 utilizes fresh site-wide content.
  • Performance: Guaranteed strict post deduplication and current post ID exclusion across all internal linking queries.
  • Optimization: Added intelligent edge-case detection (isNewSite flag & post count threshold) to support clean AI content publishing on new WordPress sites.
  • Tested: Fully validated for WordPress REST API high-concurrency standards and SEO link architecture.

3.3.0

  • Major Release: Upgraded to 12-point real-time On-Page SEO scoring engine.
  • Added native Stylized XML Sitemap index engine (/sync-sitemap.xml) with XSL stylesheet support.
  • Added intelligent entity and morphological keyword matching in first 100 words.
  • Added Table of Contents detection and AI transitional filler scrubber.
  • Added featured image alt-text verification in SEO checklist.
  • Added on-demand REST endpoints for topic uniqueness and contextual internal link discovery.
  • 100% WordPress VIP and Plugin Check (PCP) security and performance compliance.

3.2.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
